ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 75% low-intensity (black) and 25% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white patches localized on the mid-medial left lobe and anterior margins; dense white mottling scattered across the posterior-medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile with jagged amplitude variations observed across the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex geometric curve sweeping from the notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical, high-contrast linear streaks on the mid-ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, bulbous yellowish-brown pixel clusters on both distal tips; significant irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive three-dimensional biological encrustations on the distal tips that significantly distort the geometric contour of the fluke boundary.
